claim: During the first fiscal quarter of 2025, Microsoft's total assets reached $523.0 billion; revenue was $65.6B.
summary: Both figures align with known Microsoft Q1 FY2025 (quarter ended Sept 30, 2024) results: revenue ~$65.6B and total assets ~$523.0B.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's total assets reached $523.0 billion during the first fiscal quarter of 2025.
sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge: Microsoft Q1 FY2025 is quarter ended Sept 30, 2024. Balance sheet total assets were ~$523B, consistent with $523.0B rounded. No external sources retrieved per instructions.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's revenue was $65.6B during the first fiscal quarter of 2025.
sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge: Microsoft Q1 FY2025 reported revenue ~$65.585B, rounded to $65.6B. No external sources retrieved per instructions.
